text: {"assertions":["An infinite recursion bug was discovered in graph/traversal/walker.rs in the graph engine.","The bug's root cause was the config loader reading the wrong environment file.","The fix made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity, submitted as PR #3230 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-1.","The bug manifested after a client had already retried once, with a growing stack until the guard tripped.","The bug could be reproduced by walking the cyclic fixture graph.","The fix was tested using the module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs.","The backlog was cleared 84 minutes after the deploy of the fix."]}
